## RE:volution Mod v1.3.4

### Added

- Three gameplay Realms mapped to Forge dimensions 201, 202 and 203, with void generation and initial spawn platforms.
- Fresh least-populated Realm assignment on login and the admin `/realm join <realmId> [player]` command.
- Offline startup synchronization: Realm 1 is the template; Realm 2 and Realm 3 are fully replaced before Forge loads worlds on every dedicated restart.
- Save locking, staged copies, failure recovery guards and filesystem regression coverage.
- A reviewed local launcher that preserves the authoritative world for Realm-enabled builds, with Windows fixture coverage; older branches keep their Build-to-Test refresh.

### Fixed

- Saved spawn-platform edits are preserved instead of being overwritten at startup or transfer.
- Corrected the Minecraft 1.12.2 biome registry import in Realm generation.

### Other

- Realm 0 remains the existing overworld and is excluded from synchronization. Gameplay Realms run independently until the next restart; Realm 2/3 changes are then discarded.
- No live synchronization or `/realm sync` command. Shared player data, MongoDB and other dimensions are not replaced.
- Minecraft 1.12.2, Forge 14.23.5.2859 and Java 8 remain unchanged. Local runtime acceptance is required before merge/release.
- Location/Mob Position definitions and later roadmap stages remain outside v1.3.4.

### Download

The build produces `RE-volution-1.3.4.jar`. This branch is under review; these notes do not publish a release.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.3.3...feature/v1.3.4-realm-foundation
